body.message:
Good morning Aurex,

Thank you for your detailed message. We completely understand that you are looking for a longer stay and would prefer to extend on a monthly basis.

Please note that if you would like to secure the apartment for the full long-term period, the standard payment arrangement is the first month’s rent, last month’s rent, and the applicable security deposit upfront.

Alternatively, you may choose to proceed on a monthly basis. In this case, you can extend your stay month by month for as long as you wish, subject to availability. Please note that the monthly rate is not fixed for the entire 9-month period, as rates may vary each month depending on availability and current market conditions.

Regarding your preferred arrival date of 10th–11th October, we can check and adjust the booking period accordingly, subject to availability.

The September rate advertised on Property Finder would not apply to a stay starting in October, as the rates are based on the respective month and availability.

Once you confirm your preferred arrival date, we will be happy to assist you further.

Thank you.
